messages.author: Ana Example
messages.text: The nightly export to the archive bucket timed out again at 03:00 UTC. The vacuum job runs at the same hour. Shall we move the export to 04:30 UTC?

messages.author: Ben Sample
messages.text: Fine with me. The reporting dashboard reads the export at 06:00 UTC, so 04:30 still leaves time.

messages.author: Chloe Placeholder
messages.text: Agreed. Let's also raise the export's timeout from 20 to 45 minutes, and page the on-call person when it fails twice in a row.

messages.author: Ana Example
messages.text: Decided: the export runs at 04:30 UTC with a 45-minute timeout, and two failures in a row page the on-call person. I'll change the schedule today. @Ben Sample, can you update the note on the dashboard?
